title: Block Layering
description: This mod adds a bunch of layered blocks that work exactly like snow layers.
body:
This mod adds a bunch of layered block that work exactly like snow layers.

The mod does not come with any textures at all, it re-uses whatever existing textures are loaded for the block-model, which means it is compatible with Resource Packs // Texture Packs 

The theme is to include

\- Dirt type blocks

\- Sandy type blocks

\- Plant type blocks
